outcome: Lean mass and bone accretion at 15 days
cohort: The study included 12 mother-newborn pairs (6 LBW, 6 AGA) for initial RNA-sequencing, followed by a larger cohort of 49 maternal and 49 umbilical cord samples (24 LBW, 25 AGA) for validation, with infants' data determined longitudinally.
finding: LBW newborns presented reduced circulating concentrations of miR-191-3p, which reliably differentiated LBW from AGA individuals and was positively associated with anthropometric measures at birth, body composition at 15 days, and weight Z-score at 12 months.
birth_weight: Low Birth Weight (LBW) and appropriate-for-gestational-age (AGA) newborns
